blocks.label: DSU full + Kruskal
blocks.py:
parent = list(range(n)); size = [1]*n
def find(x):
    while parent[x] != x:
        parent[x] = parent[parent[x]]  # path compression halving
        x = parent[x]
    return x
def union(a, b):
    a, b = find(a), find(b)
    if a == b: return False
    if size[a] < size[b]: a, b = b, a
    parent[b] = a; size[a] += size[b]; return True
# Kruskal: sorted edges by w; union until n-1 accepted
